svg.text: open-agent-robot — system architecture

An open, hackable multimodal humanoid-robot agent. Every node, every topic and every one-ended topic on this page is derived from the source by infra/ros_census.py, and every number is read out of docs/evidence/ and printed
with the file it came from. Nothing here is remembered: infra/arch_render.py rebuilds this file, and tests/test_architecture.py fails if the committed bytes differ.
How to read this page
MacBook and browser — the laptop is the eye, ear and mouth
the bridge — WebSocket frames in, ROS 2 messages out
a process the runner launches on the GPU instance
the DDS topic bus — publish/subscribe, so nothing here is addressed
modules with no ROS import: every line runs under pytest on a laptop
AWS Bedrock — the only network dependency in the loop
derived findings: what this diagram does not show as working
One turn, in order — this is what the moving dot is doing
1 16 kHz PCM leaves the laptop over the WebSocket, 20 ms per frame
2 ws_gateway publishes /robot/ear
3 onto the bus — from here every hop is publish/subscribe
4 down the spine: one message, every subscriber, no addressee
5 asr_node transcribes it in 600 ms chunks
6 /speech/asr carries the text back
7 agent_node assembles constitution + card + L1 index + history
8 Bedrock Converse, and the reply returns along the same path to /speech/say
A dot that travels a ledger row and stops at a bar is a topic published to nobody. A hollow dot that pulses without moving is a
topic somebody subscribes to and nobody publishes. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing moves at all and this list is the whole
story, which is what makes switching the motion off safe.
ROS 2 Jazzy — DDS topic bus
10 processes, 21 topics, 50 edges — publish/subscribe, so no line here is point to point
MacBook Pro — eye, ear, mouth
daemon/main.c — C, started as a LaunchAgent because a headless daemon
can never be granted camera TCC
miniaudio capture and playback ring; ffmpeg avfoundation 720p30 to
JPEG
libwebsockets: one lws_write per writable callback, RECEIVE arrives
fragmented, and video must be prioritised or the 20 ms audio stream
starves.
Browser — the robot's face
web/robot-view/index.html
HUD: detections, gesture, subtitles
The Art 50(1) banner is verified in a real browser (T-E3) as a
computed colour rather than a class token, and hit-tested for
overlap: the token was in the CSS while all 38 boxes still rendered
slate.
SSH port-forward: ssh -F infra/ssh_config -N -f robot
The security group allows 22/tcp from one /32. No ROS port is public, and there
is no SSM fallback.
gateway/ws_gateway.py
WebSocket to ROS 2 bridge — and the only process that observes a person arriving
pub /game/events /robot/ear /robot/eye/image_raw/compressed /speech/interrupt
/speech/say
sub /game/events_out /robot/mouth /speech/interrupt /speech/tts_started
uses safety/disclosure.py
Art 50(1) is spoken by a deterministic path off the daemon 'up' frame with a per-process
latch, never by a clause in the system prompt: the disclosure still happens when Bedrock
is down.
speech/asr_node.py
paraformer-zh streaming, 600 ms chunks
pub /speech/asr
sub /robot/ear /speech/tts_active
Silent frames publish nothing at all, so there is no silence event to subscribe
to — which is why segmentation owns its own clock (T-B2).
speech/tts_node.py
Kokoro-82M zh/en at 17x realtime, with the speech/yue_server.py Cantonese sidecar
reached over a local socket
pub /robot/mouth /speech/tts_active /speech/tts_done /speech/tts_started
sub /speech/interrupt /speech/say
/speech/interrupt triggers T_FLUSH and clears the playback ring — the kill switch
an asynchronous guard is designed to pull. speech/voices.py is the only creator
of the utterance id and of the Art 50(2) synthetic marker.
GAP safety/output_guard.py has zero production callers, so /speech/say
is unguarded in fact. Recorded as NOT_WIRED, deliberately a different
value from NO_ENFORCER_TODAY: folding the two would describe an unwired
guard as protection
perception/hand_node.py
MediaPipe Tasks HandLandmarker, 8.8 classifications per second
pub /game/events_out /hand_pose
sub /robot/eye/image_raw/compressed
The thumb is excluded from the finger count, which is what fixed scissors
recognition.
perception/detect_node.py
YOLO26s TensorRT fp16 — 6.2 ms, 161 FPS on the T4
pub /agent/ask /detections /detections_msg /game/events_out
sub /robot/eye/image_raw/compressed
vision_msgs class_id is a string, not a numeric id. AGPL: demo and non-commercial
waiver only, and the node is isolated rather than opt-in.
speech/yue_server.py
CosyVoice-300M-SFT Cantonese, 3.63 s first packet
pub nothing
sub nothing
Not on the bus at all: an HTTP sidecar in its own venv, called by tts_node. It is
in the runner table because the version that was not is how Cantonese hit a
closed socket on every clean boot.
agent/agent_node.py
the only Bedrock caller in the system
pub /body/gesture /game/cmd /speech/interrupt /speech/say
sub /agent/ask /detections /game/events_out
/robot/eye/image_raw/compressed /speech/asr /speech/tts_active
Reason free, constrain late: [gesture:X] and [game:start] are parsed after
generation. Hard schema decoding reaches 100% valid and 48% executable, so moving
these to constrained decoding is a forbidden refactor rather than a clean-up.
Uses agent/context.py (the only prompt creator), agent/tools.py (the closed
registry), safety/guard.py and skills/loader.py.
game/game_node.py
System-1 reflexes — the beat never blocks
pub /agent/ask /body/gesture /game/events_out /game/rps_round
/speech/say
sub /game/cmd /hand_pose /memory/rps_table /speech/asr
/speech/tts_started
win-stay/lose-shift +0.551 pts/round, 95% CI [0.538, 0.563]
uniform opponent -0.0002, CI [-0.0006, +0.0002] — the non-inferiority
arm, and the reason the gate exists
counter-learner +0.093, gate open 71% of rounds
arm cost 0.0082 ms p50 / 0.0113 ms p95 against a 20 ms tick, 258 contexts
[100 seeds x 300 rounds — docs/evidence/track-b/opponent-h2.json, arm-
cost.json]
The stop word is a pure function of the utterance, so state-independence is a
property of the signature rather than of a state matrix. The opponent model is
asked once at arm time, and an AST test proves the beat's reachable closure never
touches it.
memory/memory_node.py
the single writer — no other process touches the files
pub /game/events_out /memory/profile
sub nothing
A second writer would break the per-line atomicity that memory/store.py exists to
provide, so every other node sends a ROS message instead.
GAP subscribes to nothing at all, so the hot layer is not fed from the
bus and no round is ever persisted
body/body_node.py
MuJoCo G1 with Dex3-1 three-finger hands
pub /joint_states
sub /body/gesture
mj_forward only: kinematic, so it cannot fall and the pelvis freejoint never
integrates. EGL offscreen at 720p. body/gestures.py is a six-key whitelist.
Five offline gates — laptop, no network, $0
pytest the suite, layers L1-L3
pytest -m mutation every named mutant plus a no-mutant control
infra/check_deploy.sh executes the runner rather than parsing it
infra/doc_counts.py the documents' numbers vs collection
infra/redact_scan.py the explicit push list, before every push
Case and mutant counts are deliberately not printed here: they live in
README.md and docs/test-design.md §0, where doc_counts.py checks them
against pytest --collect-only. A fourth hand-typed copy would be a fourth
thing to get wrong. Two of the five exit 3 rather than 0 when they cannot
run: a guard that could not run must never report clean. There is no CI —
.github/workflows does not exist, so “no checks reported” on a pull request
is the expected state, not a failure.
$HOME/oar-data/ on the instance
never in the repo, never under /tmp, mode 0700
events.jsonl append-only, per-line atomic
audit stream REWRITABLE forbids shortening
episodes.json warm layer, re-parsed by the reader
profile.json the resident card
rps_table.json per-opponent transition counts — written by nobody yet
One writer, enforced by there being one process that opens these files.
Deletion is a cascade with a receipt, not a decay curve: “forget what I
said about X” has to be a transaction, and probabilistic retrieval
suppression is not one.
AWS Bedrock — ap-southeast-1
Converse global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5
toolConfig built from agent/tools.py's closed registry
constitution 1076 tokens for 1096 chars, paid every turn
effort:low first-token median -36.8 ms, CI excludes 0: False —
output length falls to 0.875x, so it is a cost lever, not a latency
one
Guardrails STANDARD tier, n=60: mandarin p50 419.6 / p95 498.7 ms vs
the 400 ms T-G1 budget — over budget: True
[docs/evidence/track-c/*.json]
That last number is why the output guard is asynchronous with a kill switch
and never serial: one guard call at p95 already spends more than the entire
verdict-to-silence budget. Cantonese p95 is 531.6 ms, but the between-
language spread stays under the 40.6 ms replication noise ceiling (language
gap real: False), and Guardrails does not list Cantonese at all — so
latency is reported and protection is not claimed.
Topic ledger — all 21 topics, both ends counted

pub>sub is the number of publishing and subscribing processes. An amber row is published to nobody; a red row is subscribed to by somebody and published by no one. Each has a reviewed line in infra/graph_gaps.tsv and a matching entry in
the band at the bottom of this page.
/agent/ask 2>1
/body/gesture 2>1
/detections 1>1
/detections_msg 1>0 < nobody
/game/cmd 1>1
/game/events 1>0 < nobody
/game/events_out 4>2
/game/rps_round 1>0 < nobody
/hand_pose 1>1
/joint_states 1>0 < nobody
/memory/profile 1>0 < nobody
/memory/rps_table 0>1 > nobody
/robot/ear 1>1
/robot/eye/image_raw/compressed 1>3
/robot/mouth 1>1
/speech/asr 1>2
/speech/interrupt 2>2
/speech/say 3>1
/speech/tts_active 1>2
/speech/tts_done 1>0 < nobody
/speech/tts_started 1>2
32 modules that are not nodes — zero ROS import, so every line runs on the laptop under pytest

§6.1 treats testability as a design constraint: the clock, the store, the random source and the Bedrock client are all injected, because a test that needs the GPU instance is a test that will not be run. † marks a file with a __main__
block, each of which carries a reviewed exemption line in infra/standalone_entrypoints.tsv.
agent/context.py the single creator of the system prompt
agent/tools.py closed registry, derived dispatch, six outcomes
† body/gestures.py the six-key gesture whitelist; --list-joints is a dev CLI
game/opponent.py order-2..4 transitions, anytime-valid gate, 1/3 fallback
† game/opponent_harness.py T-H2..H4 offline evaluation, 100 seeds
game/rps.py the only judge, majority and vocabulary
† infra/arch_render.py this file: renders docs/architecture.svg from the census
† infra/day0_measure.py the day-0 latency measurements, by hand
† infra/doc_counts.py documented numbers vs pytest collection
† infra/entrypoints.py AST discovery of executable entrypoints
† infra/redact_scan.py redaction over the explicit push list
infra/ros_census.py the one reader of the node and topic graph
† infra/wiring_census.py unreached files, uncalled functions, unpassed params
memory/consolidate.py closed predicates, N >= 2 independent episodes
memory/erase.py cascade delete plus a receipt that carries its own gap
memory/profile.py read-only seed until unlock_for_s5()
memory/rank.py three ablation arms, never a mutated Hit.score
† memory/rank_harness.py T-F6 ablation runner; 4 exit codes, no labels = 2
memory/recall.py five paths, each reporting whether it actually ran
memory/salience.py de-biometricised; the prosody term is refused, not clamped
memory/segment.py deterministic episodes; tick(now) takes time as an argument
memory/store.py append-only, atomic swap, tombstones, seq recovery
safety/disclosure.py the Art 50(1) first-utterance text
safety/guard.py constitution, L0 stop reflex, instruction/data seam
† safety/guardrail_latency_harness.py T-K3 apply_guardrail latency, our region
safety/measure_stats.py the only median, percentile and CI implementation
safety/output_guard.py asynchronous; a serial version is unrepresentable
† safety/output_guard_harness.py T-G4 red team; 0 escapes is a floor, not a proof
† safety/token_cost_harness.py T-K5/T-F5 against Bedrock, by hand
skills/loader.py L1 index injection, read_skill_file path fence
† skills/measure_l1_tokens.py T-I1 token measurement against Bedrock, by hand
speech/voices.py the only utterance-id and Art 50(2) marker creator
What this diagram does not show as working

The first 7 are the census's own findings, one reviewed line each in infra/graph_gaps.tsv; a row that stops being true is a finding too, so these get deleted by the pull request that wires the missing end. The rest are what the graph
cannot say on its own.

dead end (external) /detections_msg — vision_msgs/Detection2DArray in the standard ROS 2 shape, published for consumers outside this repo (rviz2, another perception stack). Nothing here is meant to read it: the in-repo path is the throttled /detections
string that agent_node subscribes to, and detect_node's docstring names both

dead end (pending) /game/events — ws_gateway publishes everything arriving from the MacBook side here: browser JSON events (frame type 0x10) and the daemon up/down lifecycle. No node subscribes, so a click on the face reaches the bus and stops there —

voice is the wired path. The consumer is game_node, which today accepts commands only on /game/cmd from agent_node. Art 50(1) does not depend on this topic: ws_gateway speaks the disclosure directly on /speech/say, which is why it still works

dead end (pending) /game/rps_round — game_node hands each resolved round to the single writer fire-and-forget, per the single-writer invariant. memory_node exists as of S3 but has no subscriptions at all, so no round is persisted and the table starts empty

every boot — which is why the first ~120 rounds fall back to the 1/3 coin (81 order-2 contexts, arithmetic rather than tuning). Paired with /memory/rps_table: S5's node half wires both ends or neither

dead end (defect) /joint_states — body_node publishes it at the render tick, which round 6 found is the wrong direction — by ROS convention /joint_states is the driver's feedback topic, so on real hardware this collides with the G1 driver publishing the

same name. The fix is to publish /joint_commands and leave /joint_states to the backend. See docs/research-round6-simreal-joint-mapping-2026-08-22.md §6 and README.md, which now states the defect in the place it used to state the seam as a feature

dead end (pending) /memory/profile — memory_node publishes the read-only profile card once with transient_local durability so a late-starting node still receives it without a round trip. The consumer is agent_node's prompt assembly:

agent/context.py:assemble already takes a `card` parameter, and agent_node passes neither it nor `recall` — both are S5's node half, which needs the machine. transient_local is what makes adding the subscription later a one-line change instead of a boot-
order problem

orphan (pending) /memory/rps_table — game_node subscribes latched so a restored table is already waiting before the first round. The publisher is memory_node, which has nothing to build a table from until it subscribes to /game/rps_round. One gap counted
from both sides; the test asserts the pair stays paired, because wiring one end alone would look like progress and change nothing

dead end (unused) /speech/tts_done — tts_node announces the id of a finished utterance. Nothing consumes it and nothing is designed to: the half-duplex gate uses /speech/tts_active, the Art 50(2) synthetic marking rides /speech/tts_started, and the
segmenter's activity-transition rule reads /game/events_out. It is a published signal looking for a reason to exist

There is no MCP client, no OAuth and no token storage. That is S8's on-machine half, and it is the only reason the tool boundary could still be asserted offline at all: today the answer to "which tools can the model reach" is one name in one file, and the
moment a server answers it, the offline suite loses the ability to ask.

The offline suite contains no latency number whatsoever. T-G1 (verdict to silence <= 400 ms) and T-G2 (first-sentence delta <= 50 ms) both need the instance behind the /32, and the measurement above already shows the guard call alone spending more than the
whole T-G1 budget at p95.

T-B3's boundary F1 >= 0.80 and T-F1's 30 frozen queries need one day of real logs and one human annotation pass. Until those labels exist the S6 ablation cannot conclude, and they will not be fabricated.

RETENTION_DAYS = 90 is tested to within one second under an injected clock, but the threshold itself is a policy decision rather than a measurement, and the audit records are checked for not quoting user text by a report rather than by an enforcer.
